import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

def axL' {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)
    (h : Semiformula.rel r v ∈ Δ) (hn : Semiformula.nrel r v ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (axL Δ r v).wk (by simp[h, hn])

def all' {φ} (h : ∀' φ ∈ Δ) (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : T ⟹ Δ := d.all.wk (by simp [h])

def ex' {φ} (h : ∃' φ ∈ Δ) (t) (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (d.ex t).wk (by simp [h])

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max n m + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max' (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max m n + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

private lemma neg_ne_and {φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L} : ¬∼φ = φ ⋏ ψ :=
  ne_of_ne_complexity (by simp)

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

instance : Tait (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  verum := fun _ Δ => verum Δ
  and := fun dp dq => dp.and dq
  or := fun d => d.or
  wk := fun d ss => d.wk ss
  em := fun hp hn => em hp hn

instance : Tait.Cut (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  cut {_ _ _ dp dn} := cut dp dn

def provableOfDerivable {φ} (b : T ⟹. φ) : T ⊢ φ := b

def specialize {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1} (t : SyntacticTerm L) :
    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)
  have dn : T ⟹ ∼(∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ := by
    simp only [neg_all, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    exact Derivation.ex t (by simpa using this)
  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

def specializes : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → (v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L) →
    T ⟹ (∀* φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∀' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ := by simpa using specializes (φ := ∀' φ) (v ·.succ) b
    Derivation.cast (specialize (v 0) this) (by
      simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, ← TransitiveRewriting.comp_app, List.cons.injEq, and_true]; congr 2
      ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
      cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp)

def instances : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → {v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L} →
    T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ → T ⟹ (∃* φ) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∃' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ :=
      ex (v 0) <| Derivation.cast b <| by
        unfold Rewriting.substitute; rw [←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app]; congr 3
        ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
        cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp
    instances (k := k) (v := (v ·.succ)) (Derivation.cast this (by simp))

def allClosureFixitr {φ : SyntacticFormula L} (dp : T ⊢ φ) : (m : ℕ) → T ⊢ ∀* Rew.fixitr 0 m ▹ φ
  | 0     => by simpa
  | m + 1 => by
    simp only [allClosure_fixitr, Nat.reduceAdd]
    apply all; simpa using allClosureFixitr dp m

def toClose (b : T ⊢ φ) : T ⊢ ∀∀φ := allClosureFixitr b φ.fvSup

def toClose! (b : T ⊢! φ) : T ⊢! ∀∀φ := ⟨toClose b.get⟩

def rewrite₁ (b : T ⊢ φ) (f : ℕ → SyntacticTerm L) : T ⊢ (Rew.rewrite f) ▹ φ :=
  Derivation.cast (specializes (fun x ↦ f x) (allClosureFixitr b φ.fvSup)) (by simp)

def rewrite {Δ} : T ⟹ Δ → ∀ (f : ℕ → SyntacticTerm L), T ⟹ Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ
  | axL Δ r v,            f =>
    Derivation.cast (axL (Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) r (fun i ↦ Rew.rewrite f (v i))) (by simp[rew_rel, rew_nrel])
  | verum Δ,              f => Derivation.cast (verum (Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ)) (by simp)
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d,      f =>
    have : T ⟹ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ ⋎ Rew.rewrite f ▹ ψ :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      or (Derivation.cast (rewrite d f) (by simp))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp)
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq, f =>
    have : T ⟹ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ ⋏ Rew.rewrite f ▹ ψ :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      and (Derivation.cast (rewrite dp f) (by simp)) (Derivation.cast (rewrite dq f) (by simp))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp)
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d,       f =>
    have : T ⟹ ((Rewriting.free φ) :: Δ⁺).map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite (&0 :>ₙ fun x => Rew.shift (f x)) ▹ φ :=
      rewrite d (&0 :>ₙ fun x => Rew.shift (f x))
    have : T ⟹ (∀' Rew.rewrite (Rew.bShift ∘ f) ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      all (Derivation.cast this (by simp [free_rewrite_eq, Rewriting.shifts, shift_rewrite_eq, Finset.image_image, Function.comp_def]))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp[Rew.q_rewrite])
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ t d,      f =>
    have : T ⟹ (φ/[t] :: Δ).map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := rewrite d f
    have : T ⟹ (∃' Rew.rewrite (Rew.bShift ∘ f) ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      ex (Rew.rewrite f t) (Derivation.cast this (by simp[rewrite_subst_eq]))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp[Rew.q_rewrite])
  | @wk _ _ Δ Γ d ss,     f => (rewrite d f).wk (List.map_subset _ ss)
  | @cut _ _ Δ φ d dn,    f =>
    have dΔ : T ⟹ (Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := Derivation.cast (rewrite d f) (by simp)
    have dΓ : T ⟹ ∼(Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := Derivation.cast (rewrite dn f) (by simp)
    Derivation.cast (cut dΔ dΓ) (by simp)
  | root h,               f => rewrite₁ (root h) f

protected def map {Δ : Sequent L} (d : T ⟹ Δ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    T ⟹ Δ.map fun φ ↦ @Rew.rewriteMap L ℕ ℕ 0 f ▹ φ := rewrite d (fun x ↦ &(f x))

protected def shift {Δ : Sequent L} (d : T ⟹ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ⁺ :=
  Derivation.cast (Derivation.map d Nat.succ) (by simp only [Rewriting.shifts, List.map_inj_left]; intro _ _; rfl)

def trans (F : U ⊢* T) {Γ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Γ → U ⟹ Γ
  | axL Γ R v => axL Γ R v
  | verum Γ   => verum Γ
  | and d₁ d₂ => and (trans F d₁) (trans F d₂)
  | or d      => or (trans F d)
  | all d     => all (trans F d)
  | ex t d    => ex t (trans F d)
  | wk d ss   => wk (trans F d) ss
  | cut d₁ d₂ => cut (trans F d₁) (trans F d₂)
  | root h    => F h

instance : Tait.Axiomatized (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  root {_ _ h} := root h
  trans {_ _ _ F d} := trans (fun h ↦ F _ h) d

variable [(k : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Func k)] [(k : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Rel k)]

private def not_close' (φ) : T ⟹ [∼(∀∀φ), φ] :=
  have : T ⟹ [∃* ∼(@Rew.fixitr L 0 (fvSup φ) ▹ φ), φ] := instances (v := fun x ↦ &x) (em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp))
  Derivation.cast this (by simp [close])

def invClose (b : T ⊢ ∀∀φ) : T ⊢ φ := cut (wk b (by simp)) (not_close' φ)

def invClose! (b : T ⊢! ∀∀φ) : T ⊢! φ := ⟨invClose b.get⟩
annotation: def invClose! (b : T ⊢! ∀∀φ) : T ⊢! φ := ⟨invClose b.get⟩

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=

    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

def specialize {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1} (t : SyntacticTerm L) :
    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)

  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

    Derivation.cast (axL (Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) r (fun i ↦ Rew.rewrite f (v i))) (by simp[rew_rel, rew_nrel])
  | verum Δ,              f => Derivation.cast (verum (Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ)) (by simp)
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d,      f =>
    have : T ⟹ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ ⋎ Rew.rewrite f ▹ ψ :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      or (Derivation.cast (rewrite d f) (by simp))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp)
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq, f =>
    have : T ⟹ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ ⋏ Rew.rewrite f ▹ ψ :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      and (Derivation.cast (rewrite dp f) (by simp)) (Derivation.cast (rewrite dq f) (by simp))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp)
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d,       f =>
    have : T ⟹ ((Rewriting.free φ) :: Δ⁺).map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite (&0 :>ₙ fun x => Rew.shift (f x)) ▹ φ :=
      rewrite d (&0 :>ₙ fun x => Rew.shift (f x))
    have : T ⟹ (∀' Rew.rewrite (Rew.bShift ∘ f) ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      all (Derivation.cast this (by simp [free_rewrite_eq, Rewriting.shifts, shift_rewrite_eq, Finset.image_image, Function.comp_def]))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp[Rew.q_rewrite])
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ t d,      f =>
    have : T ⟹ (φ/[t] :: Δ).map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := rewrite d f
    have : T ⟹ (∃' Rew.rewrite (Rew.bShift ∘ f) ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      ex (Rew.rewrite f t) (Derivation.cast this (by simp[rewrite_subst_eq]))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp[Rew.q_rewrite])

def trans (F : U ⊢* T) {Γ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Γ → U ⟹ Γ
  | axL Γ R v => axL Γ R v
  | verum Γ   => verum Γ
  | and d₁ d₂ => and (trans F d₁) (trans F d₂)
  | or d      => or (trans F d)
  | all d     => all (trans F d)
  | ex t d    => ex t (trans F d)
  | wk d ss   => wk (trans F d) ss
  | cut d₁ d₂ => cut (trans F d₁) (trans F d₂)
  | root h    => F h

namespace LO.FirstOrder.Derivation

open LO.FirstOrder.Semiformula LO.FirstOrder.Rewriting LO.FirstOrder.LawfulSyntacticRewriting

variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L} {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}
  [(k : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Func k)] [(k : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Rel k)]
informal_statement: If a theory \( T \) does not prove a statement \( \sigma \), then it is equivalent to saying that \( T \) does not prove \( \sigma \) and does not prove the negation of \( \sigma \).
informal_proof:
The statement asserts the equivalence between "a theory \( T \) does not prove \( \sigma \)" and "a theory \( T \) does not prove \( \sigma \) and does not prove the negation of \( \sigma \)." Formally, this is expressed as:

\[
T \nvdash. \sigma \; \Leftrightarrow \; T \nvdash. \sigma \; \& \; T \nvdash. \lnot\sigma
\]

To understand this equivalence, consider the following:

1. **Left-Hand Side (LHS):** \( T \nvdash. \sigma \) means that the theory \( T \) does not have a formal proof for the statement \( \sigma \).

2. **Right-Hand Side (RHS):** \( T \nvdash. \sigma \; \& \; T \nvdash. \lnot\sigma \) means that the theory \( T \) does not have a formal proof for \( \sigma \) and also does not have a formal proof for the negation of \( \sigma \) (\( \lnot\sigma \)).

Since both the LHS and RHS conditions are exactly the same, the equivalence holds trivially. Therefore, the statement is proven.

In simpler terms, stating that \( T \) does not prove \( \sigma \) directly implies that \( T \) also does not prove the negation of \( \sigma \), confirming the equivalence.

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

def axL' {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)
    (h : Semiformula.rel r v ∈ Δ) (hn : Semiformula.nrel r v ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (axL Δ r v).wk (by simp[h, hn])

def all' {φ} (h : ∀' φ ∈ Δ) (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : T ⟹ Δ := d.all.wk (by simp [h])

def ex' {φ} (h : ∃' φ ∈ Δ) (t) (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (d.ex t).wk (by simp [h])

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max n m + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max' (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max m n + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

private lemma neg_ne_and {φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L} : ¬∼φ = φ ⋏ ψ :=
  ne_of_ne_complexity (by simp)

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

instance : Tait (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  verum := fun _ Δ => verum Δ
  and := fun dp dq => dp.and dq
  or := fun d => d.or
  wk := fun d ss => d.wk ss
  em := fun hp hn => em hp hn

instance : Tait.Cut (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  cut {_ _ _ dp dn} := cut dp dn

def provableOfDerivable {φ} (b : T ⟹. φ) : T ⊢ φ := b

def specialize {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1} (t : SyntacticTerm L) :
    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)
  have dn : T ⟹ ∼(∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ := by
    simp only [neg_all, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    exact Derivation.ex t (by simpa using this)
  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

def specializes : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → (v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L) →
    T ⟹ (∀* φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∀' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ := by simpa using specializes (φ := ∀' φ) (v ·.succ) b
    Derivation.cast (specialize (v 0) this) (by
      simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, ← TransitiveRewriting.comp_app, List.cons.injEq, and_true]; congr 2
      ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
      cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp)

def instances : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → {v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L} →
    T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ → T ⟹ (∃* φ) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∃' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ :=
      ex (v 0) <| Derivation.cast b <| by
        unfold Rewriting.substitute; rw [←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app]; congr 3
        ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
        cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp
    instances (k := k) (v := (v ·.succ)) (Derivation.cast this (by simp))

def allClosureFixitr {φ : SyntacticFormula L} (dp : T ⊢ φ) : (m : ℕ) → T ⊢ ∀* Rew.fixitr 0 m ▹ φ
  | 0     => by simpa
  | m + 1 => by
    simp only [allClosure_fixitr, Nat.reduceAdd]
    apply all; simpa using allClosureFixitr dp m

def toClose (b : T ⊢ φ) : T ⊢ ∀∀φ := allClosureFixitr b φ.fvSup

def toClose! (b : T ⊢! φ) : T ⊢! ∀∀φ := ⟨toClose b.get⟩

def rewrite₁ (b : T ⊢ φ) (f : ℕ → SyntacticTerm L) : T ⊢ (Rew.rewrite f) ▹ φ :=
  Derivation.cast (specializes (fun x ↦ f x) (allClosureFixitr b φ.fvSup)) (by simp)

def rewrite {Δ} : T ⟹ Δ → ∀ (f : ℕ → SyntacticTerm L), T ⟹ Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ
  | axL Δ r v,            f =>
    Derivation.cast (axL (Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) r (fun i ↦ Rew.rewrite f (v i))) (by simp[rew_rel, rew_nrel])
  | verum Δ,              f => Derivation.cast (verum (Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ)) (by simp)
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d,      f =>
    have : T ⟹ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ ⋎ Rew.rewrite f ▹ ψ :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      or (Derivation.cast (rewrite d f) (by simp))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp)
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq, f =>
    have : T ⟹ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ ⋏ Rew.rewrite f ▹ ψ :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      and (Derivation.cast (rewrite dp f) (by simp)) (Derivation.cast (rewrite dq f) (by simp))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp)
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d,       f =>
    have : T ⟹ ((Rewriting.free φ) :: Δ⁺).map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite (&0 :>ₙ fun x => Rew.shift (f x)) ▹ φ :=
      rewrite d (&0 :>ₙ fun x => Rew.shift (f x))
    have : T ⟹ (∀' Rew.rewrite (Rew.bShift ∘ f) ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      all (Derivation.cast this (by simp [free_rewrite_eq, Rewriting.shifts, shift_rewrite_eq, Finset.image_image, Function.comp_def]))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp[Rew.q_rewrite])
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ t d,      f =>
    have : T ⟹ (φ/[t] :: Δ).map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := rewrite d f
    have : T ⟹ (∃' Rew.rewrite (Rew.bShift ∘ f) ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      ex (Rew.rewrite f t) (Derivation.cast this (by simp[rewrite_subst_eq]))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp[Rew.q_rewrite])
  | @wk _ _ Δ Γ d ss,     f => (rewrite d f).wk (List.map_subset _ ss)
  | @cut _ _ Δ φ d dn,    f =>
    have dΔ : T ⟹ (Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := Derivation.cast (rewrite d f) (by simp)
    have dΓ : T ⟹ ∼(Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := Derivation.cast (rewrite dn f) (by simp)
    Derivation.cast (cut dΔ dΓ) (by simp)
  | root h,               f => rewrite₁ (root h) f

protected def map {Δ : Sequent L} (d : T ⟹ Δ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    T ⟹ Δ.map fun φ ↦ @Rew.rewriteMap L ℕ ℕ 0 f ▹ φ := rewrite d (fun x ↦ &(f x))

protected def shift {Δ : Sequent L} (d : T ⟹ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ⁺ :=
  Derivation.cast (Derivation.map d Nat.succ) (by simp only [Rewriting.shifts, List.map_inj_left]; intro _ _; rfl)

def trans (F : U ⊢* T) {Γ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Γ → U ⟹ Γ
  | axL Γ R v => axL Γ R v
  | verum Γ   => verum Γ
  | and d₁ d₂ => and (trans F d₁) (trans F d₂)
  | or d      => or (trans F d)
  | all d     => all (trans F d)
  | ex t d    => ex t (trans F d)
  | wk d ss   => wk (trans F d) ss
  | cut d₁ d₂ => cut (trans F d₁) (trans F d₂)
  | root h    => F h

instance : Tait.Axiomatized (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  root {_ _ h} := root h
  trans {_ _ _ F d} := trans (fun h ↦ F _ h) d

  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

def axL' {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)
    (h : Semiformula.rel r v ∈ Δ) (hn : Semiformula.nrel r v ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (axL Δ r v).wk (by simp[h, hn])

def all' {φ} (h : ∀' φ ∈ Δ) (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : T ⟹ Δ := d.all.wk (by simp [h])

def ex' {φ} (h : ∃' φ ∈ Δ) (t) (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (d.ex t).wk (by simp [h])

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max n m + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max' (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max m n + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

private lemma neg_ne_and {φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L} : ¬∼φ = φ ⋏ ψ :=
  ne_of_ne_complexity (by simp)

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

instance : Tait (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  verum := fun _ Δ => verum Δ
  and := fun dp dq => dp.and dq
  or := fun d => d.or
  wk := fun d ss => d.wk ss
  em := fun hp hn => em hp hn

instance : Tait.Cut (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  cut {_ _ _ dp dn} := cut dp dn

def provableOfDerivable {φ} (b : T ⟹. φ) : T ⊢ φ := b

def specialize {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1} (t : SyntacticTerm L) :
    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)
  have dn : T ⟹ ∼(∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ := by
    simp only [neg_all, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    exact Derivation.ex t (by simpa using this)
  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

def specializes : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → (v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L) →
    T ⟹ (∀* φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∀' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ := by simpa using specializes (φ := ∀' φ) (v ·.succ) b
    Derivation.cast (specialize (v 0) this) (by
      simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, ← TransitiveRewriting.comp_app, List.cons.injEq, and_true]; congr 2
      ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
      cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp)

def instances : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → {v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L} →
    T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ → T ⟹ (∃* φ) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∃' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ :=
      ex (v 0) <| Derivation.cast b <| by
        unfold Rewriting.substitute; rw [←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app]; congr 3
        ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
        cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp
    instances (k := k) (v := (v ·.succ)) (Derivation.cast this (by simp))

def allClosureFixitr {φ : SyntacticFormula L} (dp : T ⊢ φ) : (m : ℕ) → T ⊢ ∀* Rew.fixitr 0 m ▹ φ
  | 0     => by simpa
  | m + 1 => by
    simp only [allClosure_fixitr, Nat.reduceAdd]
    apply all; simpa using allClosureFixitr dp m

def toClose (b : T ⊢ φ) : T ⊢ ∀∀φ := allClosureFixitr b φ.fvSup

def toClose! (b : T ⊢! φ) : T ⊢! ∀∀φ := ⟨toClose b.get⟩

def rewrite₁ (b : T ⊢ φ) (f : ℕ → SyntacticTerm L) : T ⊢ (Rew.rewrite f) ▹ φ :=
  Derivation.cast (specializes (fun x ↦ f x) (allClosureFixitr b φ.fvSup)) (by simp)

def rewrite {Δ} : T ⟹ Δ → ∀ (f : ℕ → SyntacticTerm L), T ⟹ Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ
  | axL Δ r v,            f =>
    Derivation.cast (axL (Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) r (fun i ↦ Rew.rewrite f (v i))) (by simp[rew_rel, rew_nrel])
  | verum Δ,              f => Derivation.cast (verum (Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ)) (by simp)
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d,      f =>
    have : T ⟹ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ ⋎ Rew.rewrite f ▹ ψ :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      or (Derivation.cast (rewrite d f) (by simp))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp)
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq, f =>
    have : T ⟹ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ ⋏ Rew.rewrite f ▹ ψ :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      and (Derivation.cast (rewrite dp f) (by simp)) (Derivation.cast (rewrite dq f) (by simp))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp)
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d,       f =>
    have : T ⟹ ((Rewriting.free φ) :: Δ⁺).map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite (&0 :>ₙ fun x => Rew.shift (f x)) ▹ φ :=
      rewrite d (&0 :>ₙ fun x => Rew.shift (f x))
    have : T ⟹ (∀' Rew.rewrite (Rew.bShift ∘ f) ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      all (Derivation.cast this (by simp [free_rewrite_eq, Rewriting.shifts, shift_rewrite_eq, Finset.image_image, Function.comp_def]))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp[Rew.q_rewrite])
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ t d,      f =>
    have : T ⟹ (φ/[t] :: Δ).map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := rewrite d f
    have : T ⟹ (∃' Rew.rewrite (Rew.bShift ∘ f) ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      ex (Rew.rewrite f t) (Derivation.cast this (by simp[rewrite_subst_eq]))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp[Rew.q_rewrite])
  | @wk _ _ Δ Γ d ss,     f => (rewrite d f).wk (List.map_subset _ ss)
  | @cut _ _ Δ φ d dn,    f =>
    have dΔ : T ⟹ (Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := Derivation.cast (rewrite d f) (by simp)
    have dΓ : T ⟹ ∼(Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := Derivation.cast (rewrite dn f) (by simp)
    Derivation.cast (cut dΔ dΓ) (by simp)
  | root h,               f => rewrite₁ (root h) f

protected def map {Δ : Sequent L} (d : T ⟹ Δ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    T ⟹ Δ.map fun φ ↦ @Rew.rewriteMap L ℕ ℕ 0 f ▹ φ := rewrite d (fun x ↦ &(f x))

protected def shift {Δ : Sequent L} (d : T ⟹ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ⁺ :=
  Derivation.cast (Derivation.map d Nat.succ) (by simp only [Rewriting.shifts, List.map_inj_left]; intro _ _; rfl)

def trans (F : U ⊢* T) {Γ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Γ → U ⟹ Γ
  | axL Γ R v => axL Γ R v
  | verum Γ   => verum Γ
  | and d₁ d₂ => and (trans F d₁) (trans F d₂)
  | or d      => or (trans F d)
  | all d     => all (trans F d)
  | ex t d    => ex t (trans F d)
  | wk d ss   => wk (trans F d) ss
  | cut d₁ d₂ => cut (trans F d₁) (trans F d₂)
  | root h    => F h

instance : Tait.Axiomatized (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  root {_ _ h} := root h
  trans {_ _ _ F d} := trans (fun h ↦ F _ h) d

variable [(k : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Func k)] [(k : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Rel k)]

private def not_close' (φ) : T ⟹ [∼(∀∀φ), φ] :=
  have : T ⟹ [∃* ∼(@Rew.fixitr L 0 (fvSup φ) ▹ φ), φ] := instances (v := fun x ↦ &x) (em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp))
  Derivation.cast this (by simp [close])

def invClose (b : T ⊢ ∀∀φ) : T ⊢ φ := cut (wk b (by simp)) (not_close' φ)

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq, f =>
    have : T ⟹ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ ⋏ Rew.rewrite f ▹ ψ :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=

    have : T ⟹ ((Rewriting.free φ) :: Δ⁺).map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite (&0 :>ₙ fun x => Rew.shift (f x)) ▹ φ :=

  [(k : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Func k)] [(k : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Rel k)]
informal_statement: If a statement \( \sigma \) is provable in a theory \( T \), then the up-cast of \( \sigma \), denoted \( \uparrow\sigma \), is also provable in \( T \). Conversely, if \( \uparrow\sigma \) is provable in \( T \), then \( \sigma \) is also provable in \( T \). Therefore, the provability of \( \sigma \) and \( \uparrow\sigma \) in \( T \) are equivalent.
informal_proof:
To establish the equivalence between the provability of \( \sigma \) and \( \uparrow\sigma \) in the theory \( T \), we proceed as follows:

1. **Understanding Up-Cast**: The up-cast operation \( \uparrow \) is used to ensure compatibility between different types or representations within the theory. In Lean4, it is defined such that \( \uparrow\sigma \) is equivalent to \( \sigma \) in meaning and logical strength.

2. **Reflexivity of Equality**: The up-cast operation relies on the reflexivity of equality, which states that any object is equal to itself. Formally, \( \uparrow\sigma \) is just a convenient way to reference \( \sigma \) within different contexts without altering its fundamental properties.

3. **Forward Direction ( \( T \vdash! \sigma \Rightarrow T \vdash! \uparrow\sigma \) )**: 
   - Assume \( \sigma \) is provable in \( T \), i.e., \( T \vdash! \sigma \).
   - By the definition of up-cast, \( \uparrow\sigma \) inherits the properties and proofs of \( \sigma \).
   - Therefore, \( \uparrow\sigma \) is also provable in \( T \), i.e., \( T \vdash! \uparrow\sigma \).

4. **Reverse Direction ( \( T \vdash! \uparrow\sigma \Rightarrow T \vdash! \sigma \) )**: 
   - Assume \( \uparrow\sigma \) is provable in \( T \), i.e., \( T \vdash! \uparrow\sigma \).
   - Since \( \uparrow\sigma \) is definitionally equal to \( \sigma \), the theory \( T \) recognizes their equivalence.
   - Hence, \( \sigma \) is also provable in \( T \), i.e., \( T \vdash! \sigma \).

5. **Conclusion**: Combining both directions, we conclude that \( T \vdash! \sigma \) if and only if \( T \vdash! \uparrow\sigma \). This establishes the required equivalence in provability.

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>

  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)

    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])

    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)

    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)
  have dn : T ⟹ ∼(∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ := by
    simp only [neg_all, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    exact Derivation.ex t (by simpa using this)
  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

def specializes : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → (v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L) →

  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∀' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ := by simpa using specializes (φ := ∀' φ) (v ·.succ) b

      ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
      cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp)

  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∃' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ :=
      ex (v 0) <| Derivation.cast b <| by
        unfold Rewriting.substitute; rw [←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app]; congr 3
        ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
        cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp
    instances (k := k) (v := (v ·.succ)) (Derivation.cast this (by simp))

  | m + 1 => by
    simp only [allClosure_fixitr, Nat.reduceAdd]
    apply all; simpa using allClosureFixitr dp m

def toClose! (b : T ⊢! φ) : T ⊢! ∀∀φ := ⟨toClose b.get⟩

def rewrite₁ (b : T ⊢ φ) (f : ℕ → SyntacticTerm L) : T ⊢ (Rew.rewrite f) ▹ φ :=
  Derivation.cast (specializes (fun x ↦ f x) (allClosureFixitr b φ.fvSup)) (by simp)

def rewrite {Δ} : T ⟹ Δ → ∀ (f : ℕ → SyntacticTerm L), T ⟹ Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ
  | axL Δ r v,            f =>
    Derivation.cast (axL (Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) r (fun i ↦ Rew.rewrite f (v i))) (by simp[rew_rel, rew_nrel])
  | verum Δ,              f => Derivation.cast (verum (Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ)) (by simp)
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d,      f =>
    have : T ⟹ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ ⋎ Rew.rewrite f ▹ ψ :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      or (Derivation.cast (rewrite d f) (by simp))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp)
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq, f =>
    have : T ⟹ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ ⋏ Rew.rewrite f ▹ ψ :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      and (Derivation.cast (rewrite dp f) (by simp)) (Derivation.cast (rewrite dq f) (by simp))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp)
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d,       f =>
    have : T ⟹ ((Rewriting.free φ) :: Δ⁺).map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite (&0 :>ₙ fun x => Rew.shift (f x)) ▹ φ :=
      rewrite d (&0 :>ₙ fun x => Rew.shift (f x))
    have : T ⟹ (∀' Rew.rewrite (Rew.bShift ∘ f) ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      all (Derivation.cast this (by simp [free_rewrite_eq, Rewriting.shifts, shift_rewrite_eq, Finset.image_image, Function.comp_def]))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp[Rew.q_rewrite])
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ t d,      f =>
    have : T ⟹ (φ/[t] :: Δ).map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := rewrite d f
    have : T ⟹ (∃' Rew.rewrite (Rew.bShift ∘ f) ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      ex (Rew.rewrite f t) (Derivation.cast this (by simp[rewrite_subst_eq]))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp[Rew.q_rewrite])
  | @wk _ _ Δ Γ d ss,     f => (rewrite d f).wk (List.map_subset _ ss)
  | @cut _ _ Δ φ d dn,    f =>
    have dΔ : T ⟹ (Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := Derivation.cast (rewrite d f) (by simp)
    have dΓ : T ⟹ ∼(Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := Derivation.cast (rewrite dn f) (by simp)
    Derivation.cast (cut dΔ dΓ) (by simp)
  | root h,               f => rewrite₁ (root h) f

protected def map {Δ : Sequent L} (d : T ⟹ Δ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :

protected def shift {Δ : Sequent L} (d : T ⟹ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ⁺ :=
  Derivation.cast (Derivation.map d Nat.succ) (by simp only [Rewriting.shifts, List.map_inj_left]; intro _ _; rfl)

def trans (F : U ⊢* T) {Γ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Γ → U ⟹ Γ

  | wk d ss   => wk (trans F d) ss
  | cut d₁ d₂ => cut (trans F d₁) (trans F d₂)
  | root h    => F h

    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)
  have dn : T ⟹ ∼(∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ := by
    simp only [neg_all, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    exact Derivation.ex t (by simpa using this)
  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

def specializes : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → (v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L) →
    T ⟹ (∀* φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∀' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ := by simpa using specializes (φ := ∀' φ) (v ·.succ) b
    Derivation.cast (specialize (v 0) this) (by
      simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, ← TransitiveRewriting.comp_app, List.cons.injEq, and_true]; congr 2
      ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
      cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp)

def instances : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → {v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L} →
    T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ → T ⟹ (∃* φ) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∃' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ :=
      ex (v 0) <| Derivation.cast b <| by
        unfold Rewriting.substitute; rw [←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app]; congr 3
        ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
        cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp
    instances (k := k) (v := (v ·.succ)) (Derivation.cast this (by simp))

def allClosureFixitr {φ : SyntacticFormula L} (dp : T ⊢ φ) : (m : ℕ) → T ⊢ ∀* Rew.fixitr 0 m ▹ φ
  | 0     => by simpa
  | m + 1 => by
    simp only [allClosure_fixitr, Nat.reduceAdd]
    apply all; simpa using allClosureFixitr dp m

def toClose (b : T ⊢ φ) : T ⊢ ∀∀φ := allClosureFixitr b φ.fvSup

def toClose! (b : T ⊢! φ) : T ⊢! ∀∀φ := ⟨toClose b.get⟩

def rewrite₁ (b : T ⊢ φ) (f : ℕ → SyntacticTerm L) : T ⊢ (Rew.rewrite f) ▹ φ :=
  Derivation.cast (specializes (fun x ↦ f x) (allClosureFixitr b φ.fvSup)) (by simp)

def rewrite {Δ} : T ⟹ Δ → ∀ (f : ℕ → SyntacticTerm L), T ⟹ Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ
  | axL Δ r v,            f =>
    Derivation.cast (axL (Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) r (fun i ↦ Rew.rewrite f (v i))) (by simp[rew_rel, rew_nrel])
  | verum Δ,              f => Derivation.cast (verum (Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ)) (by simp)
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d,      f =>
    have : T ⟹ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ ⋎ Rew.rewrite f ▹ ψ :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      or (Derivation.cast (rewrite d f) (by simp))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp)
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq, f =>
    have : T ⟹ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ ⋏ Rew.rewrite f ▹ ψ :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      and (Derivation.cast (rewrite dp f) (by simp)) (Derivation.cast (rewrite dq f) (by simp))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp)
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d,       f =>
    have : T ⟹ ((Rewriting.free φ) :: Δ⁺).map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite (&0 :>ₙ fun x => Rew.shift (f x)) ▹ φ :=
      rewrite d (&0 :>ₙ fun x => Rew.shift (f x))
    have : T ⟹ (∀' Rew.rewrite (Rew.bShift ∘ f) ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      all (Derivation.cast this (by simp [free_rewrite_eq, Rewriting.shifts, shift_rewrite_eq, Finset.image_image, Function.comp_def]))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp[Rew.q_rewrite])
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ t d,      f =>
    have : T ⟹ (φ/[t] :: Δ).map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := rewrite d f
    have : T ⟹ (∃' Rew.rewrite (Rew.bShift ∘ f) ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      ex (Rew.rewrite f t) (Derivation.cast this (by simp[rewrite_subst_eq]))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp[Rew.q_rewrite])
  | @wk _ _ Δ Γ d ss,     f => (rewrite d f).wk (List.map_subset _ ss)
  | @cut _ _ Δ φ d dn,    f =>
    have dΔ : T ⟹ (Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := Derivation.cast (rewrite d f) (by simp)
    have dΓ : T ⟹ ∼(Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := Derivation.cast (rewrite dn f) (by simp)
    Derivation.cast (cut dΔ dΓ) (by simp)
  | root h,               f => rewrite₁ (root h) f

protected def map {Δ : Sequent L} (d : T ⟹ Δ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    T ⟹ Δ.map fun φ ↦ @Rew.rewriteMap L ℕ ℕ 0 f ▹ φ := rewrite d (fun x ↦ &(f x))

protected def shift {Δ : Sequent L} (d : T ⟹ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ⁺ :=
  Derivation.cast (Derivation.map d Nat.succ) (by simp only [Rewriting.shifts, List.map_inj_left]; intro _ _; rfl)

def trans (F : U ⊢* T) {Γ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Γ → U ⟹ Γ
  | axL Γ R v => axL Γ R v
  | verum Γ   => verum Γ
  | and d₁ d₂ => and (trans F d₁) (trans F d₂)
  | or d      => or (trans F d)
  | all d     => all (trans F d)
  | ex t d    => ex t (trans F d)
  | wk d ss   => wk (trans F d) ss
  | cut d₁ d₂ => cut (trans F d₁) (trans F d₂)
  | root h    => F h

instance : Tait.Axiomatized (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  root {_ _ h} := root h
  trans {_ _ _ F d} := trans (fun h ↦ F _ h) d

variable [(k : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Func k)] [(k : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Rel k)]

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

def specialize {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1} (t : SyntacticTerm L) :
    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)
  have dn : T ⟹ ∼(∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ := by
    simp only [neg_all, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    exact Derivation.ex t (by simpa using this)
  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

def specializes : {k : ℕ} → {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L k} → {Γ : Sequent L} → (v : Fin k → SyntacticTerm L) →
    T ⟹ (∀* φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∀' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ := by simpa using specializes (φ := ∀' φ) (v ·.succ) b
    Derivation.cast (specialize (v 0) this) (by
      simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, ← TransitiveRewriting.comp_app, List.cons.injEq, and_true]; congr 2
      ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]

def trans (F : U ⊢* T) {Γ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Γ → U ⟹ Γ
  | axL Γ R v => axL Γ R v
  | verum Γ   => verum Γ

  | or d      => or (trans F d)
  | all d     => all (trans F d)
  | ex t d    => ex t (trans F d)

  | cut d₁ d₂ => cut (trans F d₁) (trans F d₂)
  | root h    => F h

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

def axL' {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)
    (h : Semiformula.rel r v ∈ Δ) (hn : Semiformula.nrel r v ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (axL Δ r v).wk (by simp[h, hn])

def all' {φ} (h : ∀' φ ∈ Δ) (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : T ⟹ Δ := d.all.wk (by simp [h])

def ex' {φ} (h : ∃' φ ∈ Δ) (t) (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (d.ex t).wk (by simp [h])

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max n m + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max' (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max m n + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

private lemma neg_ne_and {φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L} : ¬∼φ = φ ⋏ ψ :=
  ne_of_ne_complexity (by simp)

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)

    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])

    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=

    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

def specialize {φ : SyntacticSemiformula L 1} (t : SyntacticTerm L) :
    T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Γ := fun d ↦
  have : T ⟹ ∼φ/[t] :: φ/[t] :: Γ := Tait.em (φ := φ/[t]) (by simp) (by simp)
  have dn : T ⟹ ∼(∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ := by
    simp only [neg_all, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]
    exact Derivation.ex t (by simpa using this)
  have dp : T ⟹ (∀' φ) :: φ/[t] :: Γ :=
    Derivation.wk d (List.cons_subset_cons _ <| by simp)
  Derivation.cut dp dn

    T ⟹ (∀* φ) :: Γ → T ⟹ (φ ⇜ v) :: Γ
  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∀' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ := by simpa using specializes (φ := ∀' φ) (v ·.succ) b
    Derivation.cast (specialize (v 0) this) (by
      simp only [Nat.reduceAdd, ← TransitiveRewriting.comp_app, List.cons.injEq, and_true]; congr 2
      ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
      cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp)

  | 0,     φ, Γ, _, b => Derivation.cast b (by simp)
  | k + 1, φ, Γ, v, b =>
    have : T ⟹ (∃' (Rew.substs (v ·.succ)).q ▹ φ) :: Γ :=
      ex (v 0) <| Derivation.cast b <| by
        unfold Rewriting.substitute; rw [←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app]; congr 3
        ext x <;> simp [Rew.comp_app]
        cases x using Fin.cases <;> simp

  | 0     => by simpa
  | m + 1 => by
    simp only [allClosure_fixitr, Nat.reduceAdd]
    apply all; simpa using allClosureFixitr dp m

def toClose (b : T ⊢ φ) : T ⊢ ∀∀φ := allClosureFixitr b φ.fvSup

def toClose! (b : T ⊢! φ) : T ⊢! ∀∀φ := ⟨toClose b.get⟩

def rewrite₁ (b : T ⊢ φ) (f : ℕ → SyntacticTerm L) : T ⊢ (Rew.rewrite f) ▹ φ :=
  Derivation.cast (specializes (fun x ↦ f x) (allClosureFixitr b φ.fvSup)) (by simp)

def rewrite {Δ} : T ⟹ Δ → ∀ (f : ℕ → SyntacticTerm L), T ⟹ Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ
  | axL Δ r v,            f =>
    Derivation.cast (axL (Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) r (fun i ↦ Rew.rewrite f (v i))) (by simp[rew_rel, rew_nrel])
  | verum Δ,              f => Derivation.cast (verum (Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ)) (by simp)
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d,      f =>
    have : T ⟹ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ ⋎ Rew.rewrite f ▹ ψ :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      or (Derivation.cast (rewrite d f) (by simp))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp)
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq, f =>
    have : T ⟹ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ ⋏ Rew.rewrite f ▹ ψ :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      and (Derivation.cast (rewrite dp f) (by simp)) (Derivation.cast (rewrite dq f) (by simp))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp)
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d,       f =>
    have : T ⟹ ((Rewriting.free φ) :: Δ⁺).map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite (&0 :>ₙ fun x => Rew.shift (f x)) ▹ φ :=
      rewrite d (&0 :>ₙ fun x => Rew.shift (f x))
    have : T ⟹ (∀' Rew.rewrite (Rew.bShift ∘ f) ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      all (Derivation.cast this (by simp [free_rewrite_eq, Rewriting.shifts, shift_rewrite_eq, Finset.image_image, Function.comp_def]))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp[Rew.q_rewrite])
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ t d,      f =>
    have : T ⟹ (φ/[t] :: Δ).map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := rewrite d f
    have : T ⟹ (∃' Rew.rewrite (Rew.bShift ∘ f) ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ :=
      ex (Rew.rewrite f t) (Derivation.cast this (by simp[rewrite_subst_eq]))
    Derivation.cast this (by simp[Rew.q_rewrite])
  | @wk _ _ Δ Γ d ss,     f => (rewrite d f).wk (List.map_subset _ ss)
  | @cut _ _ Δ φ d dn,    f =>
    have dΔ : T ⟹ (Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := Derivation.cast (rewrite d f) (by simp)
    have dΓ : T ⟹ ∼(Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) :: Δ.map fun φ ↦ Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ := Derivation.cast (rewrite dn f) (by simp)
    Derivation.cast (cut dΔ dΓ) (by simp)
  | root h,               f => rewrite₁ (root h) f

protected def map {Δ : Sequent L} (d : T ⟹ Δ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    T ⟹ Δ.map fun φ ↦ @Rew.rewriteMap L ℕ ℕ 0 f ▹ φ := rewrite d (fun x ↦ &(f x))

protected def shift {Δ : Sequent L} (d : T ⟹ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ⁺ :=
  Derivation.cast (Derivation.map d Nat.succ) (by simp only [Rewriting.shifts, List.map_inj_left]; intro _ _; rfl)

def trans (F : U ⊢* T) {Γ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Γ → U ⟹ Γ
  | axL Γ R v => axL Γ R v
  | verum Γ   => verum Γ
  | and d₁ d₂ => and (trans F d₁) (trans F d₂)
  | or d      => or (trans F d)
  | all d     => all (trans F d)
  | ex t d    => ex t (trans F d)
  | wk d ss   => wk (trans F d) ss
  | cut d₁ d₂ => cut (trans F d₁) (trans F d₂)
  | root h    => F h

instance : Tait.Axiomatized (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  root {_ _ h} := by exact?

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

def trans (F : U ⊢* T) {Γ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Γ → U ⟹ Γ
  | axL Γ R v => axL Γ R v
  | verum Γ   => verum Γ
  | and d₁ d₂ => and (trans F d₁) (trans F d₂)
  | or d      => or (trans F d)
  | all d     => all (trans F d)
  | ex t d    => ex t (trans F d)
  | wk d ss   => wk (trans F d) ss
  | cut d₁ d₂ => cut (trans F d₁) (trans F d₂)
  | root h    => F h

  root {_ _ h} := root h
  trans {_ _ _ F d} := trans (fun h ↦ F _ h) d

  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Derivation.repr
C0_dependencies.content:
protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
